barry-2016.proposed_mission: Determine benefit eligibility using the governing legal test, with usable notice and a timely opportunity to challenge adverse decisions.
proposed_criteria: For each matched record, retain the governing eligibility criteria, evidence applying each criterion, notice and correction history.

herring-2009.proposed_mission: Support arrest decisions with accurate current warrant information and effective transmission of recalls.
proposed_criteria: Compare recalled warrants with downstream arrest records and verify when each receiving system acknowledged the recall.

goodlett-warrant.proposed_mission: Support search-warrant decisions with truthful, traceable factual evidence and the applicable legal authorization.
proposed_criteria: Trace each material affidavit claim to its source and document discrepancies, review and disposition before authorization.

ciavarella-juvenile.proposed_mission: Make juvenile adjudication and placement decisions under applicable rights and welfare duties, with conflicts and financial interests disclosed and controlled.
proposed_criteria: Trace placements to their evidence and lawful criteria, and independently review disclosed and undisclosed financial connections.

ms-l-tracking.proposed_mission: Preserve reliable parent-child identity links and interagency handoffs so lawful care, contact and reunification duties can be carried out.
proposed_criteria: Reconcile person identifiers across each handoff and verify the responsible owner, location record and reunification status.

md-abbott.proposed_mission: Provide safe foster-care placements and effective case supervision within applicable child-protection duties.
proposed_criteria: Reproduce workload, placement-safety and monitoring measures from dated source records and verify corrective action on identified hazards.

santosky-kramer.proposed_mission: Decide parental-rights termination using the required evidentiary standard and procedural protections.
proposed_criteria: Show which findings satisfy each required element and evidentiary standard, with the affected person’s opportunity to contest recorded.

ferguson-2015.proposed_mission: Conduct municipal policing and court enforcement within constitutional requirements and public-safety objectives.
proposed_criteria: Audit sampled enforcement decisions, revenue incentives, court practices and documented remedies against the applicable requirements.

evans-1995.proposed_mission: Transmit warrant withdrawals accurately and promptly so police decisions use current court authority.
proposed_criteria: Confirm each quashed warrant is withdrawn from every receiving system and investigate any later reliance on the stale record.

kw-armstrong-2015.proposed_mission: Make Medicaid service-budget decisions with adequate reasons and a meaningful opportunity to challenge them.
proposed_criteria: Reproduce each challenged budget calculation from disclosed inputs and rules, and verify the notice and review pathway.

brown-plata.proposed_mission: Provide constitutionally adequate prison medical and mental-health care within operational capacity limits.
proposed_criteria: Measure care access, delays and outcomes against stated requirements, with independently reviewable capacity and correction records.

houston-evaas.proposed_mission: Support employment evaluations with reproducible scores and a meaningful opportunity to challenge consequential results.
proposed_criteria: Reproduce a sampled score from its versioned inputs and method, and record how the affected employee can identify and correct an error.

cahoo-midas.proposed_mission: Determine unemployment-fraud allegations using validated evidence and lawful notice, review and collection procedures.
proposed_criteria: Test fraud-decision rules against independently reviewed cases, record error counts and denominators, and trace corrections into collections.

mahoney-capitol-police-2026.proposed_mission: Administer access for protected expression using constitutional, consistent and reviewable permission rules.
proposed_criteria: Compare permission decisions with their stated criteria, evidence and reasons, and verify the scope of any corrective order.

turner-rogers-2011.proposed_mission: Enforce child-support obligations through lawful procedures, including adequate ability-to-pay safeguards before civil-contempt incarceration.
proposed_criteria: Before incarceration for civil contempt over unpaid child support, verify notice, financial information, opportunity to respond and an express ability-to-pay finding.

williams-detroit-2024.proposed_mission: Investigate crimes using independently corroborated evidence and documented approvals before facial-recognition-related arrests or warrant requests.
proposed_criteria: Trace a sampled facial-recognition lead to independent reliable evidence, examiner and supervisor sign-offs, written command approvals and audit follow-up.

dl-child-find-2017.proposed_mission: Identify eligible preschool children and deliver timely special-education services and transitions under the applicable duties and court order.
proposed_criteria: Reproduce delivery rates and denominators from eligibility deadlines, handoff timestamps and evidence of full required service delivery.

ralls-cfius-2014.proposed_mission: Review covered transactions for national-security risks while providing the procedural protections applicable to the affected property interests.
proposed_criteria: Verify access to legally releasable adverse evidence and a meaningful rebuttal opportunity, with nondisclosure claims separately identified and reviewed.

nelson-colorado-2017.proposed_mission: Return eligible conviction-dependent payments after invalidation through a lawful, usable refund process.
proposed_criteria: Trace a qualifying invalidated conviction through refund eligibility, responsible office, applicable deadlines and evidence of actual repayment.

jones-flowers-2006.proposed_mission: Carry out tax-sale procedures with constitutionally adequate notice and practical follow-up when delivery failure is known.
proposed_criteria: For returned unclaimed notice, document additional reasonable steps before sale when practicable and the basis for the chosen response.
